{{Quote|Admiral, this is Blue Leader standing by.|Antoc Merrick calls in for him and R2-SHW|<ref name="RO" />}}
'''R2-SHW''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]], it flew in a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] with [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]], the [[Blue Leader|leader]] of [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]], during the [[Battle of Scarif]], in which the Alliance engaged the Empire above the [[planet]] [[Scarif]] in order to try and steal the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].

During the fighting, Merrick and R2-SHW were among the members of Blue Squadron who made it through a [[Shield Gate]] above Scarif to support [[Rogue One|rebel forces]] on the surface of the planet. While fighting beneath the [[Deflector shield|shield]], R2-SHW and Merrick [[Death|perished]] when their [[starfighter]] was shot down by an [[TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter]].

==Biography==
===Scrambled for Scarif===
{{Quote|Blue Squadron, get to the surface before they close that gate.|Raddus|audio=Raddus-BlueSquadron.flac|<ref name="RO" />}}
R2-SHW was an [[R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> that flew as part of the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps|Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]'s [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Navy]] during its [[Galactic Civil War|war]] against the [[Imperial Era|reigning]] [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[astromech droid]] was part of<ref name="RO" /> the [[Massassi Group]], a portion of the rebel forces who were based in the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] of [[Yavin 4]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines" /> the forces at the temple were scrambled to fly to the planet [[Scarif]] and support a [[Rogue One|group]] of rebels there who were attempting to [[Battle of Scarif|steal]] the [[Death Star plans|plans]] to the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] from an [[Citadel Tower|Imperial compound]]. R2-SHW was loaded into an [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] that was being flown by [[General]] [[Antoc Merrick]], with the pair using the [[callsign]] [[Blue Leader]] and leading [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Blue Squadron]]. Merrick and R2-SHW jumped out of [[hyperspace]] with the rest of the Alliance [[fleet]] above Scarif, where an [[Imperial Navy|Imperial fleet]] guarded the world above a [[planetary shield]] only breachable through a [[Shield Gate]].<ref name="RO" />

[[File:R2-SHW-RO.png|thumb|left|300px|R2-SHW flew with Antoc Merrick at the Battle of Scarif.]]
Shortly after their arrival, [[Admiral]] [[Raddus]], leader of the Alliance fleet, ordered Blue [[Squadron]] to get through the gate and support the rebels on the surface below. Merrick and R2-SHW then dived toward the gate with the rest of their squadron as the Imperials began to close it. Their fighter was one of thirteen that made it through the gate before it shut, with other squadron members crashing or being trapped outside the [[Deflector shield|shield]].<ref name="RO" />

===Beached===
{{Quote|General, behind you!|A Blue Squadron pilot warns Merrick of him and R2-SHW's impending doom|<ref name="RO" />}}
[[File:R2-SHW-Hasbro.png|thumb|right|250px|R2-SHW served in the Rebel Alliance's Blue Squadron.]]
Inside the shield, Merrick and R2-SHW's fighter reached a group of rebels under attack by [[All Terrain Armored Cargo Transport]]s and managed to destroy one of the Imperial [[walker]]s. Blue Squadron then continued attacking walkers until Merrick ordered its [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] to begin deploying [[trooper]]s onto the beaches, at which point he and the other [[X-wing starfighter]]s began providing aerial cover. After a [[TIE/sk x1 experimental air superiority fighter]] began chasing one of the other Blue Squadron fighters, Merrick and R2-SHW managed to destroy the [[TIE series|TIE]].<ref name="RO" />

Alongside another Blue Squadron fighter, they then attacked a trio of TIE/sk x1s escorting a [[TIE/rp Reaper attack lander]]. The TIEs destroyed Merrick's [[wingmate]] while the general destroyed one of their number in return, but a trio of the TIE/sk x1s then pursued Merrick and R2-SHW and shot down their X-wing, [[Death|killing]] the pair when the fighter crashed into the beach and exploded. The Alliance ultimately managed to successfully steal the plans, but sustained heavy casualties in doing so.<ref name="RO" />

==Characteristics==
R2-SHW had [[Color|red]] and black paneling on its body, as well as silver and black paneling on its dome, and a black [[sensor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> As an [[R-series]] R2 unit, it was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="Manufacturer" /> and stood 0.96 [[meter]]s (3 [[Foot|ft]], 2 in) tall.<ref name="AEYNTK:UE" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-SHW first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology Series]] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. The droid was not identified in the film,<ref name="RO" /> but received a name in [[2022]] with the announcement of a figure of the droid being released in [[2023]] as part of the ''[[Star Wars: The Vintage Collection]]'' line of action figures made by [[Hasbro]]<ref name="Hasbro" />
